stem: Meena swallows a bite of roti at her home in Jaipur. What pushes the food down her food pipe into the stomach?

options.text: The food falls down to the stomach only because of gravity.
The walls of the food pipe contract and relax in a wave-like motion that pushes the food forward.
The tongue keeps pushing the food all the way to the stomach.
The stomach pulls the food down through the food pipe.

teacher.key_rationale: Food moves down the oesophagus by peristalsis: wave-like contraction and relaxation of the canal walls pushes food forward, so B is correct. A, C and D describe mechanisms that do not occur.
